metadata.description: Eight small Claude Code mods, each with its own on/off switch: hide secrets from tool results, see how far your plan is, get warned when a task is marked done with untested code, see what fills the context window, park ideas while Claude works, see your other sessions, enhance a rough prompt, and review the guesses Claude made.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides secrets in tool results before Claude reads them: the secret values of every .env and .env.* from your session's folder up to the drive root, and anything that looks like a secret (KEY=VALUE under a secret name, passwords in URLs, private keys, JWTs, AWS keys, Kubernetes Secrets); tells Claude how to use them without printing them

plugins.name: plan-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with how far your plan file is (phases and steps done, what is in progress, what is next) and Claude's own task list, kept current as files change. Starts off: /plan-meter on turns it on

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Notices when Claude marks a task done while code it changed has not been tested since, and tells Claude and you; a band shows the last test run. It warns, it never blocks. Starts off: /done-gate on turns it on

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with what fills the context window, by category, a countdown to when the prompt cache expires, and a Compact button. Starts off: /context-meter on turns it on

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: Park an idea while Claude works, without interrupting it: /idea <text>, or the shelf's own box. Ideas are kept per project across sessions, and Send puts one in the prompt box when you are ready. Starts off: /idea-shelf on turns it on

plugins.name: session-monitor
plugins.description: See your other Claude Code sessions from this one: which are working, which wait for you, which are done, and which share this folder. Each session writes a small heartbeat file; nothing else is shared. Starts off: /session-monitor on turns it on

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: An Enhance button above the prompt: Haiku rewrites your draft to name the skills that fit, the questions Claude should ask first and what done looks like. It never submits; Send does. Starts off: /prompt-enhancer on turns it on

plugins.name: assumption-check
plugins.description: After a turn that edited files or ran commands, Haiku lists the choices Claude made that you did not state. Mark each right or wrong, add a note, and send the corrections back as one prompt. Starts off: /assumption-check on turns it on
